prefixItems.description: Accounts with recent brute-force activity and their known password-history IPs. An account stays listed for at least the affected-account retention (default 24h, raised to the longest configured brute-force state lifetime) after its last counted failed or blocked request, and while it still has an IP history. An empty IP list means the history has expired. A set error marks the listing as incomplete.

account_resolution.description: Echo of the applied account resolution mode. Present only when the request asked for `account_mapping`; a missing echo means the server checked the names literally.

resolutions.description: Per requested name, independent of paging. Present only together with `account_resolution`.

items.description: How one requested account filter name was resolved through the account mappings Nauthilus stores when a backend finds a login name. A mapping is not re-verified against the backend and can be stale; a name that was never used for a login has no mapping. The literal name is always checked as well.

status.description: `mapped`: exactly one stored account. `unmapped`: no stored account, only the literal name was checked. `ambiguous`: several stored accounts, all were checked. `error`: the stored accounts could not be read, the result is undecided and the listing reports an error.

checked.description: Names tested against the affected-account state, the input first.

matched.description: Checked names that currently have affected-account state, before paging.
